title: Student Assistant for Supply Chain Data & Analytics
description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you curious about how data and analytics can shape the future of global supply chains? Join Global Supply Chain Data & Analytics and get hands-on experience turning complex supply chain data into insights and action.

Our team is part of Novonesis’ Supply Chain organization, which brings together planning, product portfolio management, and core supply chain disciplines. We partner with supply chain teams across the business to develop reporting, analytics, and data products that improve transparency, performance, and informed decision-making.

You will collaborate with global and regional stakeholders as well as our Global Competence Center in Bangalore, India, giving you exposure to an international organization and real-world supply chain challenges.

**The role & your impact**As our Student Assistant in Global Supply Chain Data & Analytics, you will help us become an even more data-driven supply chain organization.

Working closely with experienced analysts and supply chain stakeholders, you will contribute to how data is created, structured, analyzed, and transformed into actionable insights. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing digital transformation of Novonesis Supply Chain through modern data, analytics, and AI solutions.

This is an opportunity to gain practical experience with real supply chain data while developing your analytical, technical, and stakeholder management skills.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Support data collection, validation, and preparation across supply chain areas such as global planning, product costing, warehousing, logistics, and Order-to-Cash processes, using tools such as KNIME, Snowflake, Power BI/Fabric, GitHub, and VS Code.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical insights, for example in Power BI.
* Document data models, definitions, and process flows to improve transparency and data quality.
* Perform ad hoc analyses that support decision-making across supply chain teams.
* Collaborate with supply chain, IT, and analytics colleagues worldwide, with opportunities to take ownership of projects as your experience grows.

Your exact responsibilities can evolve based on your skills, interests, and academic focus.

**What you’ll need to be successful in this role**

* You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field.
* You expect to complete your studies in summer 2028 or later.
* You have a strong analytical mindset and an interest in data-driven decision-making.
* You have basic experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, KNIME, Snowflake, Power BI, SQL, or similar.
* You can structure information and communicate insights clearly.
* You are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and learning new systems.
* You are comfortable speaking and writing English on a daily basis.
* You are curious, proactive, collaborative, and eager to learn, with an eye for detail while still being able to see the bigger picture.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

* Familiarity with GitHub, VS Code, Python, or similar tools.
* An interest in supply chain processes and/or Novonesis’ production processes.
* An open-minded approach and an interest in exploring new technologies, data, and ways of working.

**What we offer you**

* Hands-on experience with real supply chain data and analytics challenges.
* Exposure to global supply chain operations and decision-making.
* Close collaboration with experienced supply chain and analytics professionals.
* Opportunities to develop practical skills across data, analytics, supply chain, and stakeholder management.
* The opportunity to build a strong professional network and valuable career skills.
* Flexible working hours designed to support your studies.

**Working conditions**The position is based on-site in Lyngby, Denmark.

You can expect to work approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility to balance your work responsibilities with your academic commitments.

**Application deadline:** November 15th, 2026. We will screen in-coming applications and invite for interviews continuously during the application period, so please apply as soon as possible.

**Contact Information:** Head of Supply Chain Insights Development Cecilie Rømer Svensgaard at CERQ@novonesis.com.

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).
